ctx.x: "Lady Play Your Mandolin" was the popular song then. But when I first started the bass in 1932, the school would let me bring the bass home. And I'd come home and turn on the radio station and Louis Armstrong was on with "Sleepy Time Down South" and "Mississippi Mud," so I tried to play along with the
band. I guess that was Pops Foster.
